_comment: a471 display rule: view -> show | fold. display is show or fold; any value but fold is read as show. Two kinds are left out of the page by `omit` (Owner 2026-11-21 19:4x JST: background rows and the replayed input are not wanted on the apps) except `omit_except`; stored lines never change and the table is read at display time, so removing an entry from `omit` brings the rows back. Default table = Tronie's, for the Owner's first live try; tune with the Owner. fold_group maps a view to the group its folded rows share (clients merge a run of one group into one line). From a folded tool_use on, every folded row up to the next shown row or the turn result is in the group fold_group.tool_use (a tool run, with fold_count 1 on the tool_use and 0 on the rest). Read at projection time only: stored events never change.
